title: CodeStaff
description: CodeStaff is a Minecraft staff plugin for suspect tracking and secure spectating with GrimAC integration. It features nickname masking, randomized coordinates, and built-in moderation tools for detecting and handling suspicious players.
body:
# CodeStaffSus

**CodeStaffSus** is a powerful staff utility plugin designed for Minecraft servers that simplifies suspect tracking, protected spectating, and cheat investigation workflows. Built with seamless GrimAC integration, it helps moderators monitor suspicious players efficiently while keeping investigations discreet.

## Features

### 🔍 Advanced Suspect Tracking

* Track and manage suspicious players through an intuitive GUI.
* Player-head based interface with pagination support.
* Manual suspect flag system for staff members.
* View and manage all active suspects in one place.

### 👁️ Protected Spectator Sessions

* Spectate players safely using `/spectate` or `/spec`.
* End spectate sessions instantly with `/sus stop`.
* Designed to prevent suspects from noticing staff investigations.

### 🎭 Nickname Masking

* Automatically hides real player identities during investigations.
* Prevents staff members from accidentally revealing investigation targets.
* Administrators can still access real player names when required.

### 📍 Coordinate Randomization

* Randomized location display while spectating.
* Helps prevent coordinate leaks and protects investigation integrity.

### ⚡ GrimAC Integration

* Compatible with GrimAC anti-cheat.
* Combine automated detections with manual staff investigations.
* Quickly review and act on suspicious players.

### 🔨 Staff Moderation Tools

* Ban the currently spectated player directly from the suspect system.
* Add manual flags with customizable amounts and check names.
* Clear flags for individual players or all players.
* Reload the configuration without restarting the server.

## Commands

### Suspect Commands

| Command                               | Description                        |
| ------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `/sus`                                | Open the suspect GUI               |
| `/sus stop`                           | Stop the current spectate session  |
| `/sus ban [player] [reason]`          | Ban the currently spectated player |
| `/sus flag <player> [amount] [check]` | Add a manual suspect flag          |
| `/sus clear <player\|all>`            | Clear suspect flags                |
| `/sus reload`                         | Reload the plugin configuration    |

### Spectate Commands

| Command              | Description                        |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `/spectate <player>` | Start a protected spectate session |
| `/spec <player>`     | Alias for `/spectate`              |

## Permissions

| Permission  | Description                                                             |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `sus.use`   | Access `/sus` and `/spectate`                                           |
| `sus.ban`   | Use suspect ban functions                                               |
| `sus.flag`  | Add manual suspect flags                                                |
| `sus.admin` | Access admin functions, reload, clear flags, and view real player names |

## Perfect For

* Practice servers
* Competitive PvP networks
* Minigame servers
* Anti-cheat moderation teams
* Staff teams that require discreet player investigations

Keep your moderation workflow professional, efficient, and invisible with **CodeStaffSus**.
